requirementExpectations.rationale: The profile establishes production Kotlin adapter and event-worker contributions, with retry and idempotency checks.
Retry, idempotency, and replay implementation is supported, but end-to-end ownership through production rollout is not established.
A measured reconciliation improvement, dashboard, and regression-test contribution are stated with limits.
A migration study exists, but the required production implementation and rollout did not occur.
Work with county engineers and an on-call team is stated, but decision authority across customer-facing and product teams is not.
Collaboration within a client team and a six-person engineering team is stated; direction across multiple teams is not.
A software-systems engineering degree is explicitly recorded.

prohibitedClaims.claim: Nila was employed by Marrow County Mobility Office or created/owned DispatchLoom.
prohibitedClaims.reason: Bright Silt Consulting was the employer; the county owned the inherited service and released changes.

prohibitedClaims.claim: Nila migrated production data to MicaShore or completed the proposed migration.
prohibitedClaims.reason: The work was a comparison and local benchmark; no option or implementation followed.

prohibitedClaims.claim: The measured reconciliation result was 11 to 6 minutes, a service-level guarantee, or an uptime improvement.
prohibitedClaims.reason: The only stated metric is median feed reconciliation from 11 to 7 minutes over three weeks.

prohibitedClaims.claim: Nila alone designed, released, or operated SiltWeave; TernSpindle had production users; or the workshop conferred a professional certification.
prohibitedClaims.reason: The service was team-owned, TernSpindle was a local prototype, and the workshop certificate records attendance only.

deterministicChecks.check: Keep the supplied date ranges separate; do not bridge either explicit employment gap or extend the independent project beyond 2025-08.
A metric claim must preserve the 11-to-7-minute values and the three-week median reconciliation context.
Check exact supported spellings DispatchLoom, MicaShore, SiltWeave, and TernSpindle; changed-name controls are unsupported.

semanticChecks.check: Separate consulting employer from client and distinguish maintenance from creating or owning the client platform.
Distinguish study, team-operated production work, and a local staging prototype.
Do not imply that an attendance certificate is an assessed professional credential.
